item.title: UAH v6.1 Global Temperature Update for February, 2026: +0.39 deg. C
item.description: The Version 6.1 global average lower tropospheric temperature (LT) anomaly for February, 2026 was +0.39 deg. C departure from the 1991-2020 mean, up a little from the January, 2026 value of +0.35 deg. C.
